"""Gera referências BSM europeias usando somente mpmath e a biblioteca padrão.

Executar fora de qualquer repositório. Precisão de trabalho: 50 dígitos;
entradas e resultados publicados: strings com 20 dígitos significativos.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
from typing import Any

import mpmath as mp

WORK_DPS = 50
CHECK_DPS = 100
SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS = 20
INPUT_FIELDS = ("S", "K", "r_cont", "q", "sigma", "T_years")
RESULT_FIELDS = (
    "call_price", "put_price", "delta_call", "delta_put", "gamma",
    "vega_per_pct_point", "theta_per_day_252", "theta_per_day_365",
    "rho_per_pct_point_call", "rho_per_pct_point_put", "d1", "d2",
)
DECIMAL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"-?[0-9]\.[0-9]{19}e[+-][0-9]+\Z")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CaseSpec:
    """Parâmetros nominais; T_source admite uma divisão explícita de inteiros."""

    case_id: str
    case_type: str
    S: str
    K: str
    r_cont: str
    q: str
    sigma: str
    T_source: str


def decimal20(value: mp.mpf) -> str:
    """Usa mantissa de vinte algarismos e expoente decimal explícito."""
    if not mp.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError("Referência não finita")
    if value == 0:
        return "0." + "0" * (SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS - 1) + "e+0"
    text = mp.nstr(
        value, n=SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS, strip_zeros=False,
        min_fixed=0, max_fixed=0, show_zero_exponent=True,
    )
    if DECIMAL_PATTERN.fullmatch(text) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"Formato decimal inesperado: {text!r}")
    return text


def normal_cdf(value: mp.mpf) -> mp.mpf:
    """Evita 1+erf nas caudas negativas, sem truncar probabilidades."""
    return mp.erfc(-value / mp.sqrt(2)) / 2


def bsm(values: dict[str, mp.mpf]) -> dict[str, mp.mpf]:
    """Preços independentes de call/put e gregas analíticas na precisão vigente."""
    S, K, r, q, sigma, T = (values[name] for name in INPUT_FIELDS)
    if not all(mp.isfinite(value) for value in values.values()):
        raise ValueError("Entradas devem ser finitas")
    if S <= 0 or K <= 0 or sigma <= 0 or T <= 0:
        raise ValueError("S, K, sigma e T devem ser estritamente positivos")
    root_T = mp.sqrt(T)
    vol_time = sigma * root_T
    d1 = (mp.log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma * sigma / 2) * T) / vol_time
    d2 = d1 - vol_time
    discount_q = mp.exp(-q * T)
    A = S * discount_q
    B = K * mp.exp(-r * T)
    density = mp.exp(-d1 * d1 / 2) / mp.sqrt(2 * mp.pi)
    Nd1, Nd2 = normal_cdf(d1), normal_cdf(d2)
    Nmd1, Nmd2 = normal_cdf(-d1), normal_cdf(-d2)
    call = A * Nd1 - B * Nd2
    put = B * Nmd2 - A * Nmd1
    theta_call_annual = -A * density * sigma / (2 * root_T) - r * B * Nd2 + q * A * Nd1
    point = mp.mpf("0.01")
    results = {
        "call_price": call,
        "put_price": put,
        "delta_call": discount_q * Nd1,
        "delta_put": -discount_q * Nmd1,
        "gamma": discount_q * density / (S * vol_time),
        "vega_per_pct_point": A * density * root_T * point,
        "theta_per_day_252": theta_call_annual / 252,
        "theta_per_day_365": theta_call_annual / 365,
        "rho_per_pct_point_call": T * B * Nd2 * point,
        "rho_per_pct_point_put": -T * B * Nmd2 * point,
        "d1": d1,
        "d2": d2,
    }
    if not all(mp.isfinite(value) for value in results.values()):
        raise ValueError("Resultado BSM não finito")
    if call <= 0 or put <= 0:
        raise ArithmeticError("Preço não positivo: possível perda numérica na cauda")
    return results


def case_specs() -> list[CaseSpec]:
    """Retorna 1 Hull + 80 grade + 5 dividendos + 6 limites, em ordem fixa."""
    specs = [CaseSpec("hull_42_40", "hull", "42", "40", "0.10", "0", "0.20", "0.5")]
    strikes = (("70", "0p70"), ("85", "0p85"), ("100", "1p00"),
               ("115", "1p15"), ("130", "1p30"))
    sigmas = (("0.05", "0p05"), ("0.2", "0p20"), ("0.6", "0p60"), ("2.0", "2p00"))
    times = (("1/252", "1d252"), ("10/252", "10d252"), ("0.5", "0p5"), ("2.0", "2p0"))
    for K, ratio_id in strikes:
        for sigma, sigma_id in sigmas:
            for T_source, time_id in times:
                specs.append(CaseSpec(
                    f"grid_ks_{ratio_id}_sigma_{sigma_id}_T_{time_id}",
                    "grid", "100", K, "0.10", "0", sigma, T_source,
                ))
    for K, ratio_id in strikes:
        specs.append(CaseSpec(
            f"q003_ks_{ratio_id}", "q_constant", "100", K, "0.10", "0.03", "0.20", "0.5",
        ))
    for K in ("90", "100", "110"):
        specs.append(CaseSpec(
            f"limit_sigma_1e-6_K{K}", "limit", "100", K, "0", "0", "0.000001", "0.5",
        ))
    for K in ("90", "100", "110"):
        specs.append(CaseSpec(
            f"limit_T_1e-9_K{K}", "limit", "100", K, "0.10", "0", "0.20", "0.000000001",
        ))
    return specs


def published_inputs(spec: CaseSpec) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Define primeiro as entradas decimais exatas que o consumidor receberá."""
    texts = {name: getattr(spec, name) for name in INPUT_FIELDS if name != "T_years"}
    if "/" in spec.T_source:
        numerator, denominator = spec.T_source.split("/")
        T = mp.mpf(numerator) / mp.mpf(denominator)
    else:
        T = mp.mpf(spec.T_source)
    return {**{name: decimal20(mp.mpf(value)) for name, value in texts.items()},
            "T_years": decimal20(T)}


def parity_residual(values: dict[str, mp.mpf], call: mp.mpf, put: mp.mpf) -> mp.mpf:
    """Resíduo assinado C-P-S*exp(-qT)+K*exp(-rT), sem impor paridade ao preço."""
    S, K, r, q, _, T = (values[name] for name in INPUT_FIELDS)
    return mp.fsum((call, -put, -S * mp.exp(-q * T), K * mp.exp(-r * T)))


def build_dataset() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Calcula a 50 dps e confirma o arredondamento dos resultados a 100 dps."""
    cases: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    residuals: list[mp.mpf] = []
    serialized_residuals: list[mp.mpf] = []
    with mp.workdps(WORK_DPS):
        specs = case_specs()
        for spec in specs:
            inputs = published_inputs(spec)
            values = {name: mp.mpf(value) for name, value in inputs.items()}
            results = bsm(values)
            residual = parity_residual(values, results["call_price"], results["put_price"])
            if abs(residual) >= mp.mpf("1e-30"):
                raise ArithmeticError(f"Falha de paridade: {spec.case_id}")
            output = {name: decimal20(results[name]) for name in RESULT_FIELDS}
            serialized = parity_residual(values, mp.mpf(output["call_price"]), mp.mpf(output["put_price"]))
            with mp.workdps(CHECK_DPS):
                checked = bsm({name: mp.mpf(value) for name, value in inputs.items()})
                for name in RESULT_FIELDS:
                    if decimal20(checked[name]) != output[name]:
                        raise ArithmeticError(f"20 dígitos instáveis: {spec.case_id}/{name}")
            cases.append({
                "case_id": spec.case_id,
                **inputs,
                **output,
                "case_type": spec.case_type,
                "parity_residual": decimal20(residual),
                "parity_residual_serialized": decimal20(serialized),
            })
            residuals.append(abs(residual))
            serialized_residuals.append(abs(serialized))
        if len(cases) != 92 or len({case["case_id"] for case in cases}) != 92:
            raise AssertionError("Cobertura ou identidade dos casos incorreta")
        for case in cases:
            for name, value in case.items():
                if not isinstance(value, str):
                    raise AssertionError("Todos os valores dos casos devem ser strings")
                if name not in ("case_id", "case_type") and DECIMAL_PATTERN.fullmatch(value) is None:
                    raise AssertionError(f"Valor fora do formato decimal: {name}")
        metadata = {
            "schema_version": "1.0.0",
            "model": "Black-Scholes-Merton; European exercise; continuous constant dividend yield q",
            "data_source": "synthetic_analytic_reference",
            "mpmath_version": mp.__version__,
            "working_precision_decimal_digits": str(WORK_DPS),
            "crosscheck_precision_decimal_digits": str(CHECK_DPS),
            "serialized_significant_digits": str(SIGNIFICANT_DIGITS),
            "numeric_representation": "decimal scientific notation in JSON strings; 1+19 mantissa digits",
            "input_policy": "Round nominal inputs to 20 significant decimal digits, then reparse those published strings at working precision before all BSM calculations.",
            "fractional_time_inputs": {"1d252": "1/252", "10d252": "10/252"},
            "fractional_time_policy": "T_years is the authoritative 20-digit decimal approximation; the rational label identifies its nominal grid origin.",
            "theta_option_type": "call",
            "theta_sign": "dC/dt = -dC/dT_years; other input parameters fixed",
            "theta_day_scaling": "annual call theta / 252 or / 365; a derivative scaling, not a finite one-day repricing",
            "vega_scaling": "dV/dsigma * 0.01; same for call and put",
            "rho_scaling": "dV/dr_cont * 0.01; q fixed; continuous-rate percentage point",
            "r_and_q_convention": "annual continuously compounded rate and continuous dividend yield, in decimal units",
            "price_units": "per one unit of underlying; S and K in the same currency; no contract multiplier",
            "parity_residual_formula": "call_price - put_price - S*exp(-q*T_years) + K*exp(-r_cont*T_years)",
            "parity_residual_scope": "computed on independent unrounded call and put at 50 dps; only the residual is then printed to 20 significant digits",
            "parity_residual_serialized_scope": "recomputed at 50 dps from the exported 20-digit call/put prices and input strings; not subject to the internal 1e-30 criterion",
            "limit_policy": "Strictly positive sigma=1e-6 or T=1e-9, separately; no zero-volatility or expiry substitution, clipping, or parity-derived put.",
            "case_counts": {name: str(count) for name, count in Counter(case["case_type"] for case in cases).items()},
            "case_count_total": str(len(cases)),
            "validation": {
                "parity_threshold_absolute": decimal20(mp.mpf("1e-30")),
                "parity_comparison": "strictly less than",
                "max_abs_parity_residual": decimal20(max(residuals)),
                "max_abs_parity_residual_serialized": decimal20(max(serialized_residuals)),
                "all_internal_parity_checks": "PASS",
                "all_result_fields_20_digits_stable_at_100_dps": "PASS",
                "output_rounding_crosschecks": str(len(cases) * len(RESULT_FIELDS)),
            },
            "references": [
                "https://book.derivative-securities.org/Chapter_BlackScholes.html",
                "https://mpmath.org/doc/current/basics.html",
                "https://mpmath.org/doc/current/general.html",
                "https://mpmath.org/doc/current/functions/expintegrals.html",
                "https://search.r-project.org/CRAN/refmans/QFRM/html/BS_Simple.html",
            ],
        }
    return {"metadata": metadata, "cases": cases}


def require_outside_repository(path: Path) -> None:
    """Recusa diretórios dentro de Git, Mercurial, Subversion ou Bazaar."""
    resolved = path.resolve()
    for parent in (resolved, *resolved.parents):
        if any((parent / marker).exists() for marker in (".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".bzr")):
            raise ValueError(f"O destino precisa ficar fora de repositórios: {parent}")
        if (parent / "HEAD").is_file() and (parent / "objects").is_dir() and (parent / "refs").is_dir():
            raise ValueError(f"Possível repositório Git bare: {parent}")


def main() -> int:
    """Emite JSON determinístico e seu SHA-256; --check verifica sem sobrescrever."""
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, default=Path(__file__).resolve().parent)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output_dir = args.output_dir.resolve()
    require_outside_repository(output_dir)
    dataset = build_dataset()
    raw = (json.dumps(dataset, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    digest = sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    target = output_dir / "bsm_reference_cases.json"
    checksum = output_dir / "bsm_reference_cases.sha256"
    checksum_text = f"{digest}  {target.name}\n"
    if args.check:
        if target.read_bytes() != raw or checksum.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != checksum_text:
            raise ValueError("Os arquivos não correspondem à regeneração determinística")
    else:
        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        if target.exists() or checksum.exists():
            raise FileExistsError("Saída existente; use --check ou escolha outra pasta vazia")
        target.write_bytes(raw)
        checksum.write_text(checksum_text, encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({
        "status": "PASS", "mode": "check" if args.check else "generate",
        "cases": len(dataset["cases"]), "sha256": digest,
        "json": str(target), "validation": dataset["metadata"]["validation"],
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
